import paramiko, time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Same fix as before for main
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i '448a\    if (!this.persistence) { console.warn(\"[WorldTick.init] Persistence not available\"); return; }' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("Added null check")
# Tick guard
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i 's|setInterval(() => this.tick(), 100)|setInterval(() => this.observerEngine ? this.tick() : null, 100)|g' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("Tick guard")
# saveAll guard
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i 's|const allPlayers = this.playerSystem.getAllPlayers()|const allPlayers = this.playerSystem?.getAllPlayers?.() ?? []|g' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("saveAll guard")
# Restart
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart areloria 2>&1 | tail -2")
time.sleep(8)
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000")
print("HTTP:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
